label: TP
reason: User input from HTTP header flows directly into SQL query via string concatenation without parameterized query protection. The conditional (500/42)+num=207>200 always evaluates true, ensuring param always becomes bar and enters the SQL query. While ESAPI encoder exists in exception handler, it doesn't protect the main execution path.

evidence.note: User input from Header flows through decode(), condition always true, concatenating into SQL query enabling SQL injection
